This magazine is optimized for recoil control.

  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Gutshot Straight
perks.desc: Aiming down sights increases body shot damage, decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Tear
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.desc: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

perks.name: Omolon Fluid Dynamics
perks.desc: This weapon has increased reload speed and stability for the top half of the magazine.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 152 from 2 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5y3KdXwOHAdEiERuX1NtGR?si=87414268eb9642d6) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for use against Minor adds in general at-level or better content. Auric Disabler's precision frame intrinsic means ×0.8 yaw recoil, so recoil is essentially vertical. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good, which is improved further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and mag perks are enhanced - d2foundry.gg calculates that 63 Range equates to 18.63m hipfire and 29.80m ADS before damage dropoff, 46 Stability is ×1.0813 flinch resist, 46 Handling is 0.39s ready, 0.30s ADS and 0.36s stow speed, 48 Reload Speed is 1.84s reload and Magazine Size is 40 (max 45). You can be quite flexible with the barrel perk choice, and look for a little extra Handling and Range. In the magazine perk slot, there are the combat effect mags or look to boost Reload Speed. There aren't any reload options in the first trait perk column, but you can roll an AoE Damage perk with with either Dragonfly for a 4.5m explosion, or Hatchling to spawn a Threadling on a crit kill. Pair that with Onslaught to increase rate of fire, and therefore DPS, from 450 RPM to 714.29 RPM after three kills or Desperate Measures for up to ×1.3 damage for 7s for weapon and ability kills, refreshable on additional kills. If you're interested "Auric" means of, relating to, or derived from gold. The Fleet Footed Origin Trait's additional Airborne Effectiveness and Movement Speed are more of a PvP perk. Roar of Battle's +10 Handling and Stability is better, but unspectacular or for compulsive reloaders, Omolon Fluid Dynamics boost Stability by up to +20 and Reload Speed by up to +30 in the top half of the mag. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
